General Information

What is This Part?
This is the Back-Up Switch Sensor for the 1989 – 1995 Samurai and SJ413.
Screws into the Transmission.
This switch activates the Reverse Lights when the Shifter is Moved into the Reverse Position.
So if the reverse lights don™t work on your Sammy then this is the likely culprit.
Inexpensive and easy to install.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Back-up Switch (Square Plug)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1989 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1989 – 1995 All Models
